summary: Feed s071_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 not seen, 50% of packets arrive untagged, reducing SIEM segmentation visibility.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20 to this SIEM port. 50% untagged with VLAN 20 completely absent indicates VLAN filtering or an access-mode output stripping tags rather than a SPAN/TAP issue.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses VLAN context for half the traffic and has zero visibility into VLAN 20. VLAN-based correlation, filtering, and detection rules for VLAN 20 will not fire, creating a blind spot.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward trunked VLANs 10 and 20 to the SIEM tool port so segmentation context is restored.
